signals_info.description: Whether the target-side blind spot is occupied; 0 means unoccupied.

nl_Literal_translation_en: For the next 5 seconds, the target-side blind spot shall remain unoccupied.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 在接下来的 5 秒内，目标侧盲区应始终处于未被占用状态。
nl_Paraphrase_en: Throughout the 5-second lane-change segment, the target-side blind spot shall remain clear.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 在 5 秒的变道区间内，目标侧盲区应持续保持无占用。
